title.ja: 正規稀少尾の通常importance sampling
title.en: Ordinary importance sampling of a normal rare tail

summary.ja: 通常の尤度比平均を解析モーメント・独立seed分散・有限被覆診断で確認。
summary.en: Check ordinary likelihood-ratio averages with analytic moments,independent batch variance and finite coverage diagnostics.

algorithm.ja: Y=1(X>a)exp(-aX+a²/2)の通常平均。ランダムな重み総和で割らず、proposal調整なし。直接MCの無hitは0のまま保存しCP区間を付けます。
algorithm.en: Ordinary mean ofY=1(X>a)exp(-aX+a²/2),without random weight normalization or proposal tuning. Retain direct zero-hit counts with Clopper-Pearson intervals.

validation.ja: 1〜4次モーメントを独立正の積分で資格。既知分散による5SE校正、seed間分散、解析分散低減、重み欠落負例。既知分散normal95%のIS区間の被覆は閾値/prefixごと64反復で別記。
validation.en: Qualify moments1..4 by independent positive quadrature. Gate known-variance5SE,batch variance,analytic variance reduction and omitted-weight negative control. Report known-variance normal95IScoverage separately for64trials per threshold/prefix.

limits.ja: 重み付きISへBernoulliの厳密区間を転用しません。64反復は一般95%被覆の証明でなく、nestedprefixを独立反復へ水増ししません。global weightESSと事象ESSは別です。
limits.en: Bernoulli exact intervals are not applied to weighted IS.64trials do not prove general95%coverage;nested prefixes are not extra independent replicates. Global weightESS and eventESS are distinct.

review_level.ja: 著者一次章の選択箇所＋独立モーメント積分
review_level.en: Selected author-primary exposition plus independent moment quadrature

references.author: A. B. Owen
references.title: Monte Carlo theory,methods and examples,Chapter9: importance sampling

review.ja: 準備時に著者版9章のsupport・通常IS平均・2次モーメントと重み診断の選択箇所を確認。今回の再取得は403。全書籍やPERT実験を再現しません。
review.en: Selected author-chapter support,ordinary estimator,second moments and diagnostics were read during preparation. Current refetch returned403. No full-book or PERT experiment reproduction.

caption.ja: 保存した実データ由来の分布・誤差診断。空間次元と標本/時間軸を区別します。
caption.en: Distribution and error diagnostics from actual saved data;sample/time axes are distinguished from spatial dimensions.

title.en: Joint target and MCSE for a correlated bivariate Gaussian

summary.ja: 実2D MH軌道を既知のjointモーメントと同一データArviZ診断で検査。
summary.en: Test actual2D MH paths against known joint moments and same-data ArviZ diagnostics.

assumptions.ja: 平均(1,-1)、相関.95・対角分散1。4独立chainset×4chain、burn1024/draw8192、prefix2048/8192。固定.9Lzと.25z、適応なし。

algorithm.ja: 対称random-walk MH、拒否状態も保持。8観測量それぞれのoriginal-scale meanESS/MCSEを計算し、rankbulkESSを流用しません。
algorithm.en: Symmetric random-walk MH retains rejected states. Compute original-scale meanESS/MCSE separately for8observables;rank bulkESS is not substituted.

validation.ja: 4つのpreconditioned最終prefix全観測量にRhat/ESS/MCSE/既知moment条件。同じ128scalararrayを別ArviZ0.20過程へ渡した640値資格と全データSHAで照合。標的は解析Gaussianモーメントで別検査。 640比較は不変な同一データfixture上で行い、別に生成する8組のfresh軌道で物理・混合判定を行います。環境を跨ぐ生成配列のbit一致は要求しません。
validation.en: Gate all full-prefix observables in4preconditioned chainsets by Rhat/ESS/MCSE/knownmoments. Match exact dataSHAand640values from128scalar arrays in a separateArviZ0.20process. Target law is separately checked by analytic Gaussian moments. All640comparisons use the immutable same-data fixture;8freshchainsets independently receive the unchanged physical/mixing gates. No portable generated-byte-identity claim.

limits.ja: 診断engineの独立性とsamplerの独立参照を混同しません。Rhat等は大域収束・被覆の証明ではありません。isotropicは固定比較で失敗を要求せず、banana/funnel/HMC/NUTSは未実装です。
limits.en: Diagnostic-engine independence is not an independent sampler. Rhat/ESS/MCSE do not prove global convergence/coverage. Isotropic is descriptive with no required failure;banana/funnel/HMC/NUTSremain unimplemented.

review_level.ja: 原著診断定義と公式実装選択確認・実同一データ資格
review_level.en: Selected original definitions,official implementation and actual same-data qualification

references.title: Rank-normalization,folding,and localization: An improved R-hat for assessing convergence of MCMC

review.ja: 原著のrank/folded Rhat・ESSの選択節と修正Blom式を確認。多変量大域収束の認証ではありません。
review.en: Read selected original rank/foldedRhat,ESS and corrected Blom equation. No multivariate global-convergence certificate.

references.author: ArviZ developers
references.title: ArviZ0.20.0 public diagnostics API and selected implementation

review.ja: 公式0.20.0のESS/MCSE実装とAPIを確認。実際の固定8chainsetの128観測量prefix配列を別過程へ渡す640値資格を保存します。独立性は診断実装でありsampler独立参照ではありません。
review.en: Read official0.20.0 ESS/MCSE source and API. Cache640values from128same-data observable/prefix arrays of8fixed chainsets in a separate process. Independence is the diagnostic engine,not an independent sampler.
